summary: Founder Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting two financing transactions. First, an exchange agreement with Streeterville Capital partitioned $8M from a $16.07M secured convertible note into a non-convertible secured promissory note at 6% interest maturing December 11, 2027. Second, a securities purchase agreement with Avondale Capital for up to $20M in pre-paid purchases of Class A ordinary shares, with an initial $1.08M tranche (after $80K in fees/discount) at 8% interest. No premium, price per share, board recommendation, or advisors are disclosed. The filings are routine debt restructurings and equity-linked financing, not a special situation; the pre-paid purchase structure resembles an ATM equity line. Watch for shareholder dilution and conversion mechanics.
